newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$10.00 cubic metre or C$1.59/barrel, effective immediately.
The new prices were listed as follows:

Edmonton light sweet C$197.00/cubic metre, or C$31.32/barrel Cromer light sour C$191.00/cubic metre, or C$30.37/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$158.00/cubic metre, or C$25.12/barrel Midale at Cromer C$166.00/cubic metre, or C$26.39/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
